address: 1F, 5-2 Liuying Road, Shangcheng, Hangzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: With years of experience in Japanese cuisine, the head chef pushes the boundaries of Franco-Japanese fusion by cleverly incorporating subtle Chinese twists. In addition to three set menus that are revamped every four to six months, top-notch sashimi showcasing precise knife work are a firm fixture all year round. The counter seats overlooking the open kitchen provide the best view if you are a cookery buff. Booking essential.
